svg.title: Russian 'bioregulator' peptides: what the published evidence is
svg.desc: Russian 'bioregulator' peptides: what the published evidence is. Vilon: 3 studies giving it to people, 63 lab or animal studies, 5 reviews. Vesugen: 5 studies giving it to people, 19 lab or animal studies, 1 reviews. Cartalax: 0 studies giving it to people, 6 lab or animal studies, 0 reviews. Bronchogen: 0 studies giving it to people, 7 lab or animal studies, 0 reviews.
